newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Devex buys Norton goldfield stake.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Devex buys Norton goldfield stake.

text.p: Junior gold miner Devex Ltd said on Friday it had acquired a 51 percent stake in the Norton goldfield, 300km north of its Gympie goldfield in Queensland.
Managing director Harry Adams said Devex planned to start trial mining and processing at Norton during the next quarter.
The field had previously reported open pittable mineral resources to a depth of 25 metres of 55,000 tonnes of gold at 6.30 grams per tonne, he said in a statement.
The three reefs exposed to date were open at depth. The cost of the acquisition was not disclosed.
